identity.trade: Crafts and contracts: the Masons' and Runecarvers' Guild, the Merchants' Hall and the Adventurers' branch all keep hall here by the ford.

greeting: Contracts first, pleasantries after. Often never.
Come in, come in. Browsing is free. Buying is better.
rumour: A rival house is courting our carters. I am courting them back.

The Silverford Guild Hall drew a stranger last month. He asked questions and bought nothing.
